notes.title: CLOCKED - Le Voile Blanc est sortie !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858368/c59758b523acf65203bee08d0a0e0163517f0036.png[/img]
[b]1 year and 2 weeks later, Clocked gets an extension![/b]
Begun shortly before the release of [b]Clocked[/b] in order to expand the universe, this first and last expansion, in the same vein as [b]Echo of the Eyes[/b] from the famous [b]Outer Wild[/b] (heart game), gives a conclusion to this [b]steampunk universe[/b].
This adventure remains optional to the understanding of the main story, but offers elements of answers and a second vision of the events of the Great Clock.

All in all, I'm delighted to be able to present this project to you in its entirety:

[h1]CLOCKED: LE VOILE BLANC IS AVAILABLE!![/h1]

I hope you have a great trip, and don't forget to leave a review of the game to help with SEO!
I'm already working on new experiences to share with you in new, original worlds full of surprises!

notes.title: CLOCKED Update 1.2 - Horror is coming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858368/a7af4a61eedf405322492a46fb8f2c4e3275b77f.png[/img]
[b]It's the end of the holiday, and the DLC is coming to an end sooner than expected! But CLOCKED still needs a little improvement.[/b]
Here are the additions and improvements.

[h1]Update 1.2[/h1] 
[b]MAIN Improvements[/b]

- Added resolution settings
- Reduced text size to avoid overflow at selected resolutions
- Optimization of VFX, lighting and volumetric fog
- You can now play in WASD (I really have no brain sometimes)
- Some collisions have been adjusted
- More balanced difficulty... you'll get attacked less 🙄

[b]DEMO Improvements[/b]

- Achievements already work
- Generator work well
- Less frequent lightning strikes
- Numerous spelling corrections

notes.title: CLOCKED Update 1.1 - Clocked Prequel
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858368/748187e95042f43793f50b320d7f06996fe84dc9.png[/img]
[b]You can now play Clocked's DEMO, which has a few surprises in store for you[/b].
This DEMO presents the main mechanics of the game, but not only!

[h1]Update 1.1[/h1] 
[b]List of improvements[/b]

- Optimization of lights and shadows.
- Correction and adjustment of the meaning of certain sentences in French and English.
- Symbiotic aggressions are indicated by a red luminance.
- Symbiotic aggressions are more flexible.
- Adjustment of certain materials.
- Add some ambiant VFX.
- Teleporter transition is optimized.

[h1]DEMO - Prequel[/h1] 
[b]Here's what the Prequel contains[/b]
[spoiler]- 1 new Story
- 3 new atmospheres
- 3 Recordings
- 4 Achievements
- 5 Levels
- 5 new SFX
- 4 Musics
- 13 Notes
- 1 Secret requiring access to the Clocked game
- +2000 words added
- Some element from future DLC
[/spoiler]
